title: Ashley Fox Estates
description: A UK estate agency platform for buying, renting and selling — property search, landlord services, short-term lets, valuations and marketing tools for homeowners and investors.
content:
Ashley Fox Estates is a full-service property platform covering sales, lettings, short-term stays and landlord management. Visitors can search homes, request valuations, explore FOMO property alerts and access advice for buyers, sellers, tenants and landlords.

  • Buy, rent and sell property journeys with dedicated advice hubs
  • Landlord lettings, management protection and guaranteed rent options
  • Short-term guest services including vetting, check-in and linen
  • Property alerts, valuations and multi-platform listing tools
tech_stack: Laravel · PHP · MySQL · Livewire · Tailwind CSS
role: Full-stack Laravel development — property search, sales/lettings flows, landlord tools and marketing content.
business_flow: Search Property → View Listing → Enquire / Valuation → Agent Follow-up → Sale or Let
technical: Built as a Laravel property platform with searchable listings, enquiry and valuation workflows, content hubs for buyers/sellers/landlords, and marketing modules for FOMO alerts and multi-platform listings.
features: Buy, rent and sell property search and listing pages
Landlord lettings, management and guaranteed rent options
Short-term guest services and property maintenance tools
Request a valuation and FOMO property alerts
Advice hubs for buyers, sellers, tenants and landlords
Multi-platform listings, photography and price optimisation services

title: Bnb Booking
description: An Airbnb-style short-stay marketplace for homes and apartments — search by destination and dates, book with secure payments, and host listings from a guest and host portal.
content:
Bnb Booking is a short-stay rental platform for city breaks, work trips and longer visits. Guests search verified homes by destination, dates and guests, then book with upfront pricing. Hosts list properties, message guests and manage stays from their dashboard.

  • Search and filters for stays, dates, guests and amenities
  • Property detail pages with galleries, amenities, calendar and booking
  • Guest and host accounts, wishlists, trips and in-app messaging
  • Identity-checked hosts and secure checkout
tech_stack: Laravel 12 · Livewire · PHP 8.2 · MySQL · Pusher · Laravel Socialite
role: Full-stack Laravel development — guest/host portals, booking flow, payments, and messaging.
business_flow: Search → Property Detail → Book → Pay → Host Confirm → Stay → Review
technical: Built with Laravel 12 and Livewire for reactive booking UI, MySQL for listings and calendars, Pusher for real-time messaging, and Socialite for OAuth sign-in. Covers guest search, host dashboards, wishlists, and secure checkout.
features: Search and filters for stays, dates, guests and amenities
Property detail pages with galleries, amenities and calendar
Guest and host accounts with wishlists and trips
In-app messaging between guests and hosts

title: Construction 360
description: A design-led construction website for a London contractor — services, project case studies, insights and quote enquiries, with an admin CMS to manage content.
content:
Construction 360 is a Laravel marketing site and CMS for a London design-and-build contractor. The public site covers the full service catalogue, project portfolio, leadership team, insights and a quote enquiry form. An admin panel manages services, projects, blogs, team, partners and incoming queries.

  • Service and sub-service pages across pre-construction, structural, MEP and interiors
  • Project case studies and blog/insights
  • Contact and quote enquiry workflow with file uploads
  • Admin CMS for content, services, projects, team and partners
tech_stack: Laravel 12 · PHP 8.2 · MySQL · Tailwind CSS · Vite
role: Full-stack Laravel development — marketing site, quote workflow, and CMS admin.
business_flow: Browse Services → View Projects → Request Quote → Admin Review → Follow-up
technical: Laravel 12 marketing site and CMS with Tailwind and Vite. Public pages cover services, portfolio, team and insights; admin manages content, enquiries and partners.
features: Project case studies and insights blog
Contact and quote enquiry with file uploads
Admin CMS for services, projects, team and partners

title: Property Sourcing Group
description: A UK property deal-sourcing platform that matches investors with below-market-value deals from agents — including search, offers, viewings, Stripe payments and branded PDF brochures.
content:
Property Sourcing Group is a Laravel platform that connects deal-sourcing agents with property investors across the UK. Agents list off-market and below-market-value deals; investors set budgets, locations and strategies; and an automated matching engine notifies the right buyers.

  • Property search with location, price, yield, category and deal-type filters
  • Investor and agent portals with inquiries, offers, viewings and messaging
  • Smart matching by region, radius, budget and investment strategy
  • Stripe checkout for reservation, exchange and completion fees
  • White-label PDF brochures, WhatsApp/Twilio alerts and Spatie role-based admin
tech_stack: Laravel 12 · PHP 8.2 · MySQL · Bootstrap 5 · Tailwind CSS · Vite · Stripe · Twilio · Spatie Permission · DomPDF
role: Full-stack Laravel development — investor/agent portals, matching engine, Stripe and PDF brochures.
business_flow: Agent Lists Deal → Match Investors → Inquiry → Offer → Viewing → Stripe Fees → Completion
technical: Laravel 12 platform with Bootstrap/Tailwind UI, Stripe checkout, Twilio alerts, Spatie permissions and DomPDF white-label brochures. Includes smart matching by region, budget and strategy.
features: Property search with location, price, yield and deal-type filters
Investor and agent portals with offers, viewings and messaging
Smart matching by region, radius, budget and strategy
Stripe checkout for reservation and completion fees
White-label PDF brochures and WhatsApp/Twilio alerts

title: Nahj
description: A complete Human Resources Management System built with Laravel 11, covering employee management, attendance and payroll.
role: Full-stack Laravel HRMS development — employees, attendance and payroll modules.
business_flow: Hire Employee → Attendance → Leave → Payroll Run → Payslip → Reports
technical: Laravel 11 HR management system covering employee records, attendance tracking and payroll processing on MySQL.
features: Role-based access for HR and managers

title: Propco CRM
description: PropCo CRM is a comprehensive real estate Customer Relationship Management system built with Laravel. It streamlines property management, lead generation, contact management, and sales processes for real estate agencies.
role: Full-stack Laravel CRM development — properties, leads, contacts and sales pipeline.
business_flow: Lead Capture → Qualify → Assign Agent → Viewing → Offer → Sale → Follow-up
technical: PropCo CRM is a Laravel + Livewire real-estate CRM with Bootstrap UI, covering property inventory, lead generation, contact management and sales workflows.

title: Staggar
description: A celebrity-fan interaction platform built with Laravel and Blade, with comprehensive documentation.
tech_stack: Laravel 12 · Livewire · Stripe Connect · Pusher · Google OAuth · MySQL
role: Full-stack Laravel development — celebrity-fan platform, payments and real-time features.
business_flow: Fan Discovers Talent → Request → Pay → Talent Delivers → Review
technical: Laravel 12 with Livewire, Stripe Connect payouts, Pusher real-time updates and Google OAuth. Built for celebrity-fan interactions with documented flows.

title: QuoteEngine
description: A multi-tenant SaaS for managing partner quotations across construction projects — log and compare quotes side by side, track partners through an onboarding pipeline, schedule follow-ups and report on spend.
tech_stack: Next.js 15 · React 19 · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Prisma · MySQL · Stripe
role: Full-stack Next.js SaaS development — multi-tenant quotations, partners and reporting.
business_flow: Invite Partner → Collect Quotes → Compare Side-by-Side → Follow-up → Report Spend
technical: Next.js 15 / React 19 TypeScript SaaS with Prisma and MySQL, Tailwind UI and Stripe billing. Multi-tenant quotation comparison and partner onboarding pipeline.

title: TMS
description: A multi-tenant lead-management and marketing CRM platform — capture leads through funnels and forms, distribute them to referral partners in real time, and track commissions, appointments and biometric attendance.
tech_stack: Laravel 10 · Livewire 3 · PHP · MySQL · Sanctum · ZKTeco · Tailwind CSS
role: Full-stack Laravel CRM development — lead funnels, partner distribution and attendance.
business_flow: Lead Captured → Score/Route → Assign Partner → Appointment → Commission → Attendance Sync
technical: Laravel 10 + Livewire 3 multi-tenant CRM with Sanctum APIs, Tailwind UI and ZKTeco biometric attendance integration for partners and commissions.
features: Lead capture through funnels and forms

title: ShortStay
description: A full-featured, Airbnb-style short-term rental marketplace where guests discover and book stays and hosts list and manage properties — with escrow payments, real-time messaging and a complete admin back office.
tech_stack: Laravel 12 · Livewire · Stripe Connect · Pusher · Google Maps · MySQL
role: Full-stack Laravel marketplace development — guest/host flows, escrow and admin.
business_flow: List Property → Guest Books → Escrow Hold → Stay → Release Payment → Review
technical: Laravel 12 short-term rental marketplace with Livewire, Stripe Connect escrow, Pusher messaging, Google Maps and a full admin back office.
features: Guest discovery and booking of short stays
